title: Tiny, cute tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <rect x='15' y='82' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2a5a2a'/>
  <!-- rear wheel outer -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='16' fill='#222244'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='13' fill='#333366'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='7' fill='#88aaff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='3' fill='#334488'/>
  <!-- rear wheel treads -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#5566aa' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='4 4'/>
  <!-- front wheel outer -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='10' fill='#222244'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='8' fill='#333366'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='4' fill='#88aaff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='2' fill='#334488'/>
  <!-- front wheel treads -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#5566aa' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='3 3'/>
  <!-- tractor body -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='52' height='24' rx='6' fill='#e84040'/>
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='52' height='24' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#ff7070' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='54' y='52' width='24' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ff6050'/>
  <rect x='54' y='52' width='24' height='16' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#ff9090' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- grill lines -->
  <line x1='62' y1='53' x2='62' y2='66' stroke='#ffcccc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='53' x2='67' y2='66' stroke='#ffcccc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='53' x2='72' y2='66' stroke='#ffcccc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='70' y='38' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#8888aa'/>
  <rect x='68' y='35' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#aaaacc'/>
  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='32' r='3' fill='#ccccdd' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='27' r='2.5' fill='#ccccdd' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='23' r='2' fill='#ccccdd' opacity='0.3'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='26' height='20' rx='4' fill='#4499ee'/>
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='26' height='20' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#88bbff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cab window -->
  <rect x='29' y='34' width='16' height='12' rx='2' fill='#99ddff'/>
  <rect x='29' y='34' width='16' height='12' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#bbeeff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x='22' y='26' width='30' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3377cc'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffee55'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <!-- fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d='M16 62 Q16 54 26 54 L38 54 Q48 54 48 62' fill='#cc3333' stroke='#ff6060' stroke-width='2'/>
</svg>
